summary: A volume in the world that the server watches. An area is either the level's own, kind 'level', meaning each TriggerArea and SmartAreaShape on the server's map, such as houses, interiors, private grounds, stealth areas and settlements, with labels the game's AI reads. Or it is built by a resource with Area.create, kind 'script', as a box, sphere or polygon with a height. areaEnter and areaExit fire when a player, horse or NPC goes in or out. The server checks only bodies that moved, against nearby areas, so a body standing still costs nothing. Z is up. Changes from create, setShape and enabled are checked once your code returns, so their events come after the call, while destroy fires exits at once.

create.summary: Creates an area from a definition.

params.definition: `id`, required, unique, 1 to 128 characters; `name`; `type`, 'box', 'sphere' or 'shape'; `position`, the centre, and `rotation`; for a box, `min` and `max`, with each part of max above min; for a sphere, `radius`; for a shape, `points`, 3 to 256 in the XY plane, and `height`, where 0 means no floor or ceiling; `labels`, up to 64; `metadata`, JSON up to 65536 characters; `enabled`, default true; `dimension`, or null for all; `collision`, invisible walls on the outline, default false, with `wallBottom` and `wallTop` for a box or shape, and `wallThickness`, 0.05 to 2 m, default 0.2.

create.exampleLua:
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

kcds.world.Area.create({ id = "town-gate", type = "box", position = Vector3.new(100, 200, 10), min = Vector3.new(-5, -5, -2), max = Vector3.new(5, 5, 4), labels = { "town" } })

kcds.core.Events.on("areaEnter", function(area, entity, matchingDimension)
  if area.id == "town-gate" and matchingDimension then
    print("entered: " .. tostring(entity.id))
  end
end)

getById.summary: The area with this id, or null. A script area's id is the one it was created with. A level area's is its EntityGuid as sixteen hex digits, in any case, which is the same on all computers and after restarts.

params.id: A script area's id, or a level area's sixteen hex digits.

getById.exampleLua:
-- The inn of Troskovice, one of trosecko's own areas.
local inn = kcds.world.Area.getById("108c8fabab6e4bf9")
if inn then
  print(inn.name, table.concat(inn.labels, ", "), inn.height)
end

getAt.summary: All enabled level and script areas containing a position, in no defined order.

params.dimension: Optional: skips script areas tied to another dimension.

getAt.example:
const here = kcds.world.Area.getAt(player.position);
const indoors = here.some((area) => area.labels.includes('interior'));
getAt.exampleLua:
local indoors = false
for _, area in ipairs(kcds.world.Area.getAt(player.position)) do
  for _, label in ipairs(area.labels) do
    if label == "interior" then
      indoors = true
    end
  end
end
getAt.exampleCs:
var here = Area.GetAt(player.Position);
var indoors = here.Any(area => area.Labels.Contains("interior"));

aroundEntity.summary: All enabled areas now containing a player, horse or NPC, in its dimension.

params.body: A Player, Horse or Npc the server holds.

aroundEntity.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCommand", function(player, command)
  if command ~= "where" then
    return
  end
  local names = {}
  for _, area in ipairs(kcds.world.Area.aroundEntity(player)) do
    table.insert(names, area.name)
  end
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, table.concat(names, ", ") or "nowhere in particular")
end)

nearby.summary: Areas within a radius of a position, closest first, including disabled ones. Distance is measured to their bounds.

params.radius: Metres from the areas' bounds, 0 or more.
params.dimension: Optional: skips script areas tied to another dimension.

nearby.exampleLua:
local names = {}
for _, area in ipairs(kcds.world.Area.nearby(player.position, 30)) do
  if area.kind == "level" and area.type == "TriggerArea" then
    table.insert(names, area.name)
  end
end
print(table.concat(names, ", "))

taggedWith.summary: All areas with a label, ignoring case, with level areas first.

params.label: The label, such as 'private', 'interior' or your own.

taggedWith.example:
const privateAreas = kcds.world.Area.taggedWith('private');
console.info(`${privateAreas.length} private areas on this map`);
taggedWith.exampleLua:
local privateAreas = kcds.world.Area.taggedWith("private")
print(tostring(#privateAreas) .. " private areas on this map")
taggedWith.exampleCs:
var privateAreas = Area.TaggedWith("private");
Log.Info($"{privateAreas.Length} private areas on this map");

all.summary: All areas the server knows, level areas first, about 3,300 on trosecko and 6,900 on kutnohorsko, then your resources'.
all.exampleLua:
local interiors = {}
for _, area in ipairs(kcds.world.Area.all("level")) do
  for _, label in ipairs(area.labels) do
    if label == "interior" then
      table.insert(interiors, area)
      break
    end
  end
end
print(#interiors .. " interiors")

exists.summary: False once a script area is destroyed, and all reads then give empty values. A level area exists while the server runs its map.
exists.exampleLua:
if not area.exists then
  print("destroyed")
end

id.summary: A stable key for saving an area: a script area's id, or a level area's EntityGuid as sixteen lower-case hex digits.

kind.summary: 'level' for the level's own, 'script' for those from Area.create.
kind.example:
const own = kcds.world.Area.all().filter((area) => area.kind === 'script');
console.info(`${own.length} areas from resources`);
kind.exampleLua:
local own = {}
for _, area in ipairs(kcds.world.Area.all()) do
  if area.kind == "script" then
    table.insert(own, area)
  end
end
print(tostring(#own) .. " areas from resources")
kind.exampleCs:
var own = Area.All().Where(area => area.Kind.AsString() == "script").ToArray();
Log.Info($"{own.Length} areas from resources");

type.summary: A level area's entity class, 'TriggerArea', a prism baked into the level, 'SmartAreaShape', the outline of a settlement or location, or 'AreaUnion', a house of several rooms. Or a script area's shape, 'box', 'sphere' or 'shape'.

name.summary: The level's entity name, such as 'pracharna_areaMarker_inn', or the script area's name. Only a script area's can be assigned, and a level area's throws.

labels.summary: The area's labels. A level area has the game's own, 'private', 'personal', 'semipersonal', 'semipublic', 'interior', 'prohibited', 'stealthArea_crouch', 'dogForbidden', 'suppressHorseCall' and others its AI reads, and they cannot change. Assign a new array to change a script area's.
labels.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("areaEnter", function(area, entity)
  local private = false
  for _, label in ipairs(area.labels) do
    private = private or label == "private"
  end
  -- a player has a nickname, other entities do not
  if private and entity.nickname ~= nil then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(entity, "You are on private ground.")
  end
end)

metadata.summary: Your JSON data on a script area. To change it, read, edit and assign it. Level areas always have {}, and assigning throws.
metadata.example:
const stall = kcds.world.Area.getById('market-stall');
stall.metadata = { ...stall.metadata, owner: player.nickname };
metadata.exampleLua:
local stall = kcds.world.Area.getById("market-stall")
local metadata = {}
for key, value in pairs(stall.metadata or {}) do
  metadata[key] = value
end
metadata.owner = player.name
stall.metadata = metadata

collision.summary: Script areas only. Invisible walls on the outline that all games collide with, from both sides, while enabled: a box's four sides, a shape's edges, or a sphere's closed shell. A shape needs a height above the thickness and edges that do not cross. Walls follow setShape, enabled and dimension, and go with destroy. False by default. You can assign to it. It throws a TypeError for a non-boolean or on a level area, and a RangeError if the shape cannot take walls that thick.
collision.exampleLua:
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local pen = kcds.world.Area.create({ id = "pen", type = "box", position = Vector3.new(1650, 2150, 35), min = Vector3.new(-4, -4, 0), max = Vector3.new(4, 4, 3), collision = true })
pen.wallTop = true
collision.exampleCs:
var pen = Area.Create(new { id = "pen", type = "box", position = new Vector3(1650, 2150, 35), min = new Vector3(-4, -4, 0), max = new Vector3(4, 4, 3), collision = true });
pen.WallTop = true;

enabled.summary: Whether the area fires events and getAt finds it. You can assign to it, on level areas too. Once your code returns, turning it off fires areaExit for everyone inside, and turning it on fires areaEnter.
enabled.exampleLua:
for _, area in ipairs(kcds.world.Area.taggedWith("stealthArea_crouch")) do
  area.enabled = false
end

dimension.summary: A script area's dimension, or null if not tied to one. A level area is in all (null) and cannot be assigned one.

position.summary: A script area's centre, from which its shape is placed, and assigning moves it. A level area's is the centre of its bounds and cannot be assigned.

rotation.summary: A script area's rotation, and assigning turns it. Level areas use world coordinates directly, so theirs is always the identity and read-only.
rotation.exampleCs:
// the same Euler angles in degrees JavaScript passes
arena.AsValue().Set("rotation", new { z = 45 });

height.summary: How far a shape reaches above its lowest corner, in metres, where 0 means no floor or ceiling. A TriggerArea's comes from the level's prism. For a box, it is the height of its bounds, and for a sphere, 0.

location.summary: Reserved, always ''. The server does not yet know which map location a SmartAreaShape represents.

bounds.summary: The bounding box in world coordinates, { min, max }. With no ceiling, it extends a long way vertically.
bounds.example:
const { min, max } = area.bounds;
console.info(`from ${min} to ${max}`);
bounds.exampleLua:
local min, max = area.bounds.min, area.bounds.max
print("from " .. tostring(min) .. " to " .. tostring(max))

members.summary: An AreaUnion's member areas. A level's house of several rooms is one area, with type 'AreaUnion' and the house's labels, that a body is inside while in any room. Empty for other areas.
members.exampleLua:
local houses = {}
for _, area in ipairs(kcds.world.Area.all("level")) do
  if area.type == "AreaUnion" then
    table.insert(houses, area)
  end
end
for _, house in ipairs(houses) do
  print(tostring(house.name) .. ": " .. tostring(#house.members) .. " rooms")
end

lockKey.summary: The key for this area's doors and chests. It reads as an item class id, or '' for none, and you assign an item class by name or GUID, or null to remove it. Whoever carries it gets the game's Unlock prompt on each locked door and chest in the area, and a Lock hint on the U key on an unlocked one. A door's key from door.setKey, or a chest's from stash.keyClass, comes first, so a supervisor's key can open what others' cannot. The area's level chests become the server's through Stash.adopt. Throws a TypeError for an item class that does not exist.
lockKey.exampleLua:
local house = kcds.world.Area.getById("006588875df00335")
if house then
  house.lockKey = "key_home"
  house:setLocked(true)
end

setLocked.summary: Locks or unlocks all doors and chests in the area, and a door that locks also closes. Returns how many it reached, with a door counting once a player's game has shown it. Throws a TypeError for anything except true or false.

params.locked: True to lock, false to unlock.

setLocked.exampleLua:
local house = kcds.world.Area.getById("006588875df00335")
if house then
  print(tostring(house:setLocked(true)) .. " locks closed")
end

doors.summary: Doors the level links to this area, each { guid, name, position, link }, where `link` is 'entrance', 'basic' or 'storage'. Door.find takes the guid. Empty for a script area or one with no links. No player needs to be near.
doors.exampleLua:
for _, door in ipairs(area.doors) do
  print(door.link, door.guid)
end

players.summary: Players now inside, in any dimension.
players.example:
const inn = kcds.world.Area.getById('108c8fabab6e4bf9');
console.info(`${inn.players.length} players in the inn`);
players.exampleLua:
local inn = kcds.world.Area.getById("108c8fabab6e4bf9")
print(tostring(#inn.players) .. " players in the inn")
players.exampleCs:
var inn = Area.GetById("108c8fabab6e4bf9");
Log.Info($"{inn.Players.Length} players in the inn");

occupants.summary: All bodies now inside, in any dimension: players, horses and NPCs.
occupants.exampleLua:
for _, body in ipairs(area.occupants) do
  print(body.nickname or body.name)
end

herbsWithin.summary: The level's herbs available to pick inside the area's current shape in a dimension, with no player needed nearby. It ignores `enabled` and leaves out picked, removed and turned-off plants. Empty for a destroyed area or a dimension the area is not in.

params.dimension: Optional: by default the area's own, or the shared one for an area in all.

herbsWithin.exampleLua:
local meadow = kcds.world.Area.getById("meadow")
local kinds, count = {}, 0
for _, herb in ipairs(meadow:herbsWithin()) do
  if not kinds[herb.kind] then
    kinds[herb.kind] = true
    count = count + 1
  end
end
print(count .. " kinds of herb grow in the meadow")

clearHerbs.summary: Removes the level's herbs inside the area in a dimension, including picked ones, until a respawn or server restart, with no items, XP or harvest events. They stay away whatever later happens to the area's shape or state. Returns how many were not already removed, or 0 for a destroyed area or a dimension it is not in.

params.dimension: Optional: by default the area's own, or the shared one for an area in all.

regrowHerbs.summary: Brings back picked and removed plants inside the area in a dimension at once, including those with regrowth off. Returns how many picks and removals ended, or 0 for a destroyed area or a dimension it is not in.

params.dimension: Optional: by default the area's own, or the shared one for an area in all.

regrowHerbs.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCommand", function(player, command)
  if command == "regrow" then
    local area = kcds.world.Area.getById("garden")
    if area then
      area:regrowHerbs()
    end
  end
end)

contains.summary: Whether a position is inside by geometry alone, whether enabled or not, in any dimension.
contains.exampleLua:
local inn = kcds.world.Area.getById("108c8fabab6e4bf9")
if inn:contains(kcds.math.Vector3.new(2340, 2070, 110)) then
  print("that spot is in the inn")
end

holdsEntity.summary: Whether a player, horse or NPC is inside now, in the area's dimension. A level area is in all.

params.body: A Player, Horse or Npc the server holds. Anything else throws.

holdsEntity.exampleLua:
local inn = kcds.world.Area.getById("108c8fabab6e4bf9")

kcds.core.Events.on("playerCommand", function(player, command)
  if command == "drink" and not inn:holdsEntity(player) then
    kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Drinks are served in the inn.")
  end
end)

setShape.summary: Moves, turns or reshapes a script area, leaving omitted fields unchanged. After your code returns, areaEnter and areaExit fire for anything affected.

params.definition: The shape fields to change, as for Area.create: type, position, rotation, min, max, radius, points, height.

setShape.example:
// The ring grows as the fight goes on.
kcds.world.Area.getById('arena').setShape({ radius: 20 });
setShape.exampleLua:
-- The ring grows as the fight goes on.
kcds.world.Area.getById("arena"):setShape({ radius = 20 })
setShape.exampleCs:
// The ring grows as the fight goes on.
Area.GetById("arena").SetShape(new { radius = 20 });

destroy.summary: Removes a script area. Everyone inside gets areaExit first, while the object still works. Returns false if it is already gone or is a level area, which cannot be removed, though you can turn it off with enabled.
destroy.exampleLua:
local area = kcds.world.Area.getById("event-zone")
if area then
  area:destroy()
end

wallBottom.summary: For box and shape areas with collision, adds a plate across the whole interior at the bottom, as strips one metre wide for a shape. False by default, and a sphere is always closed. You can assign to it. It throws a TypeError for a non-boolean or on a level area.

wallTop.summary: For box and shape areas with collision, adds a plate across the whole interior at the top. False by default. You can assign to it. It throws a TypeError for a non-boolean or on a level area.

wallThickness.summary: Wall thickness in metres, across the outline: 0.05 to 2, default 0.2. You can assign it on script areas. A value out of range, or too large for the shape with collision on, throws a RangeError. Level areas throw a TypeError.
